title: O Spread The Tidings 'Round
firstLine: O spread the tiding around, Wherever man is found,

lines: O spread the tiding around, Wherever man is found,
Wherever human hearts and human woes abound;
Let every Christian tongue proclaim the joyful sound:
Our Lord is Lord of lords.
Lo, the great King of kings, with healing in His wings,
To every captive soul a full deliverance brings;
And through the vacant cells the song of triumph rings;
Our Lord is King of kings.
O, boundless love divine! how shall this tongue of mine
To wondering mortals tell the matchless grace divine
That I, in earth's decline should in His image shine!
In Him, the word of heaven.
Of lords, He is the Lord! Divine, the living Word!
His name, the sweetest heard: His will redemption brings;
O spread the tiding around, wherever man is found -
The Lord is King of kings.
